newsitem.title: UK: Rio Tinto plays catch-up, upgrade helps.
newsitem.headline: Rio Tinto plays catch-up, upgrade helps.

text.p: Shares in international resources group Rio Tinto Plc rose on Wednesday, helped by an upgrade from brokers SBC Warburg after the stock's recent underperformance.
The shares were up 17-1/2p to 10.07-1/2 stg by 0935 GMT.
Analysts at SBC Warburg upgraded the stock to "hold" from "reduce" on valuation factors, market sources said.
The shares have underperformed the FTSE 100 index by 19 percent and the All-share index by 15 percent over the last twelve months.

Meanwhile technical analysts at Merrill Lynch described Rio Tinto as a "classic late cycle play" as commodity stocks are usually the last to enter a bull market when perceptions of inflation begin to creep up.
